sourceOfTruth: Finding r1-2, re-run against this head before a row was written. The GRAMMAR is not invented here: `cycle-state.mjs` L203-208 already owns it — `export const isWorkflowVersion = v => typeof v === 'string' && /^\d+\.\d+\.\d+$/.test(v)`, with the comment 'a version outside this grammar is a version the command did not really get: publish already refuses a handoff carrying one, so accepting it anywhere upstream only mints an identity nothing downstream can use'. `publish` (L1250) enforces it and `inputs --story` (L2422) was closed by r1-g2. The VALUE is owned by `.claude/workflows/pair-implement-batch.js:482` — `const WORKFLOW_VERSION = '4.0.1'`, the sibling realization of this same cycle. Neither file is in fixScope: both are the authority, not the thing under repair. REPAIR (attempt 2): the set of entry points is no longer a hand-written list. It is re-derived from the CLI's OWN declared argument table — `const FLAGS = {…}` in cycle-state.mjs L2358-2369, the object its CLI refuses unknown flags against — which declares `workflowVersion` for FIVE subcommands: resolve, publish, inputs, apply-scope-decisions (L2365) and migrate-acknowledge (L2368). The rows read that table at run time, so a sixth declaring subcommand is covered the day it is added (and a declaring subcommand with no invocation fails the row loudly, rather than being skipped).
